gbm_population_evidence.quote: Grade IV glioma (glioblastoma and its variants according to the World Health Organization 2021), confirmed in tissue at time of initial diagnosis. Tumors with an IDH 1 or 2 mutation are excluded.

candidate_evidence.quote: Eligible patients will be sequentially enrolled to receive intravenous domvanalimab (AB 154) combined with zimberelimab (AB 122) (N=6).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First or second recurrence after treatment. Prior treatment must include at least radiation therapy.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacodynamic effects of each pre-surgery treatment will be evaluated with single-cell RNA sequencing of tumor and blood to determine effects of each intervention on the immune response.

Resected tumors in cohorts B1 to 4 will be analyzed utilizing immunofluorescence for the ratio between Tregs and CD8 T cells, calculated by counting cells that are positive for a FoxP3 or a CD8 staining.

role_evidence.quote: Domvanalimab (AB 154) is a humanized immunoglobulin G1 (IgG1) monoclonal antibody that targets TIGIT.
Following surgery, all patients will initiate treatment with the combination of domvanalimab (AB 154) and zimberelimab (AB 122).
Zimberelimab (AB122) is a fully human immunoglobulin G4 (hIgG4) monoclonal antibody (mAb) that targets PD-1.
Following surgery, all patients will initiate treatment with the combination of domvanalimab (AB 154) and zimberelimab (AB 122).
Saline placebo comparator for pre-surgery treatment in cohort B4

source_quote.quote: Sequencing of IDH 1 and 2 is not required but, at a minimum, a negative result for the presence of IDH-1 R132H mutation on IHC is required for eligibility.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Treg (FoxP3) to CD8 T-cell ratio in resected tumour

source_quote.quote: Resected tumors in cohorts B1 to 4 will be analyzed utilizing immunofluorescence for the ratio between Tregs and CD8 T cells, calculated by counting cells that are positive for a FoxP3 or a CD8 staining.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: single-cell RNA sequencing immune response profile (tumour and blood)

source_quote.quote: Single cell RNA sequencing of tumor and blood after exposure to AB154 with and without AB122

coder_notes: Phase 0/I (EARLY_PHASE1) window trial. All arms (including placebo cohort B4) receive domvanalimab + zimberelimab after surgery; pre-surgical randomisation includes single agents and placebo. Cohort B4 (EXPERIMENTAL-labelled) functions as placebo control for the pre-surgical PD comparison, so control_arm_from_other_arms = yes. Placebo listed as control_comparator for completeness. IDH-wildtype is a diagnostic eligibility criterion, never candidate-matched.
